messages:
Ava Lin: Quick check — finalizing ops for Wed's on-demand workshop (Scaling LLM inference). Need a short checklist: registration page, Zoom settings, recording flow, transcript+clip pipeline, and lead routing. Can we confirm owners?
Sam Ortiz: I can own registration page + confirmation email. Draft is ready, just waiting on CTA copy and UTM tags.
Ava Lin: Thanks Sam. CTA copy: 'Watch the workshop — learn production inference patterns'. UTM: utm_medium=email, utm_source=webinar_reg, utm_campaign=llm_inference_apr2026
Luis Chen: I will take Zoom config and recordings. Notes below: enable cloud recording, record separate audio files, enable auto-transcription, and turn on "Record active speaker, gallery view". Also enable auto-delete after 90 days for GDPR.
Devon (events): Adding: set meeting to require registration, enable passcode, disable join before host, turn on waiting room, and enable live streaming to a staging RTMP for internal recording backup. I'll add the co-hosts: @Luis and @Maya.
Maya Patel: I'll handle post-event clips and social snippets. Ask production to export 5 clips: 30s highlight, 60s demo, 90s customer quote, 45s tips, and 15s teaser. Please include timestamps in the transcript.
Sam Ortiz: For registration page: include question fields: company, title, work email, country. Add a hidden field: marketing_segment (value: webinar_llm_apr2026). Also add consent checkbox and link to privacy.
Ava Lin: Lead routing rules: if company_size > 500 => sales-enterprise; company_size 51-500 => sales-midmarket; else => nurture. Also tag leads that watched >50% as "engaged" and push to SFDC with lead_source=webinar and lead_score +10.
Luis Chen: Post-processing pipeline (rough): Zoom cloud recording -> wait for transcript -> webhook to our clipper job -> run ffmpeg trims -> upload clips to S3 and attach to notion. Example ffmpeg snippet: `ffmpeg -ss 00:10:30 -to 00:11:00 -i meeting.mp4 -c copy clip_1.mp4`
Devon (events): Automation: webinar-bot will post a thread in #marketing when recording is ready with links. webhook: https://hooks.redwood-internal/jobs/webinar-processing (production uses auth token).
Maya Patel: For transcripts: use the Zoom auto-transcript as a first pass, then run our ASR-cleaner job to fix speaker labels. Output: timestamped paragraphs for social clipping and a CSV with timestamps for highlight extraction.
Ava Lin: Follow-ups: Day 0 (within 24h) — send replay + resource links + CTA (1:Book a demo 2:Read benchmarks). Day 3 — highlight clip email (30s). Day 14 — nurture sequence with benchmark whitepaper.
Sam Ortiz: I'll add UTM variants for each follow-up: replay_email_v1, clips_v1, nurture_v1. Also adding link tracking for clicks and video watch %.
Luis Chen: One gotcha — Zoom sometimes delays transcripts by hours. Add a fallback: if transcript not ready in 6h, trigger ASR pass on raw audio stored in S3.
Devon (events): Confirmed owners: Registration/Emails = Sam; Zoom/Recordings = Luis; Clips/Social = Maya; Post-event orchestration/workflow = Devon. I'll create a calendar event with tasks.
Ava Lin: Awesome — please drop final checklist and the registration URL here when live. :tada:
webinar-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-05-06 09:00 UTC — Send rehearsal reminder to hosts.
